jobs.da_jr: Junior Data Analyst. 1+ years of experience with SQL and Excel. Build dashboards in Power BI, reporting for the sales team, pivot tables and data cleaning.
jobs.da_bi: BI Analyst. 2 years of experience with Tableau, SQL and statistics. Create dashboards and KPI reporting, hypothesis testing and A/B analysis for marketing.
jobs.de_cloud: Data Engineer. 3+ years of experience building ETL data pipelines with Python, Apache Airflow, Spark and AWS (S3, Glue, Redshift). Data modeling in Snowflake.
jobs.de_azure: Data Engineer Azure. 4 years of experience with Azure Data Factory, Databricks, PySpark and SQL. Design ELT pipelines and data integration.
jobs.ds_ml: Data Scientist. 3 years of experience in machine learning, predictive modeling and classification with Python, pandas, scikit-learn and statistics.
jobs.ai_llm: AI Engineer. 2+ years of experience with LLMs, PyTorch, TensorFlow, NLP and deploying machine learning models with Docker and REST APIs.
jobs.fe_react: Frontend Developer. 3 years of experience with React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML and CSS. Build responsive UIs and consume REST APIs.
jobs.be_python: Backend Developer Python. 4 years of experience with Django or FastAPI, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Docker and Git. Design microservices.
jobs.be_node: Backend Developer Node.js. 3 years of experience with JavaScript, Node.js, Express, MongoDB and REST APIs.
jobs.devops: DevOps Engineer. 5+ years of experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Linux and AWS infrastructure monitoring.
jobs.sales: Sales Executive. 2 years of experience in B2B sales, negotiation, CRM (Salesforce) and meeting commercial targets.
jobs.accountant: Accountant. 3 years of experience in accounting, taxes, financial statements, payroll and SAP.

data_analyst.raw_text: Data analyst with 2 years of experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI and Tableau. SQL queries, Excel pivot tables, statistics and data cleaning with Python pandas for sales and marketing teams.
